articles.summary: We pointed Claude's new science agent at a public Cell Painting dataset through the Quilt MCP. With no human-written code it went from raw data to 25 tested hypotheses, six figures, and a versioned results package. Here's the full run, plus how to set up the same connector on Quilt Open or your own data.
articles.title: Claude Science Meets the Quilt MCP: From Public Cell Painting Data to 25 Tested Hypotheses
